AccessProgramNameNote: Provisional name of the program that gives access to the world of MPAI Apps; change it here and run make-aif-pages.py again.

Platforms.Title: Windows
Platforms.Summary: The AIF for Windows 10 and 11 on 64-bit Intel and AMD processors.

Platforms.Title: Linux
Platforms.Summary: The same Controller, in a package for Linux. The L3s and the Apps do not change; the packages of the AIMs and the programs they use are made for Linux.

Platforms.Title: macOS
Platforms.Summary: The same Controller, in a package for macOS. The L3s and the Apps do not change.

Platforms.Title: Android
Platforms.Summary: A phone or a tablet holds the microphone, the camera and the screen. The Apps run on an MPAI-MAS Service and the access program is its client.

Platforms.Title: iOS
Platforms.Summary: An iPhone or an iPad holds the microphone, the camera and the screen. The Apps run on an MPAI-MAS Service and the access program is its client.
